description: Frozen after the exploratory run, before replay training. Unseen question wording for taught domain facts, plus six new general-task controls. Do not select checkpoints using these answers.

questions.question: Explain what fuczki are to an English-speaking diner, including their characteristic cabbage ingredient.
Where in Poland do proziaki belong, and what ingredient makes these little breads rise?
Which seeds form the basis of siemieniotka, and when would a Silesian family traditionally serve it?
Describe wodzionka and explain which ageing kitchen staple it puts to use.
Describe the baked treats called fafernuchy and name the seasoning behind their spicy taste.
Which two characteristic ingredients are scattered over a cebularz flatbread?
Name the city associated with rogal swietomarcinski and describe its distinctive seed filling.
Describe the form of hreczanyki and identify the grain used in them.
What are kacapoly made from, and which sort of cheese is their filling?
Explain the predominant milk source and the smoking treatment of oscypek.
Explain how a Krakow szopka combines a Christmas religious scene with representations of its home city.
Describe the Polish flower-carpet custom: name the feast and explain where the carpets are arranged.
How does a Koniakow lace maker use a hand tool to produce this local textile craft?
Explain the decorative art that makes the homes of Zalipie recognizable.
Describe Lajkonik's rider costume and the animal represented around his waist.
Explain whose memory is honoured in the folk custom of Dziady and the role of offerings.

controls.prompt: Which city is the capital of Italy?
Give the chemical formula for sodium chloride.
Which planet is commonly called the Red Planet?
What secondary colour is made by mixing blue and yellow paint?
